method: Seven alternating 64 MiB UI trials per build and path, reversing order each round. Same direct workerd bundle, no WebSocket compression, same native binary, original 4 MiB source reads. Both candidate changes independently regress browser-to-browser, so neither is retained. Baseline builds use source 806bb37 with identical retained frontend code. No profile overhead.
compatibilityFinding: Splitting one encrypted record across relay WebSocket messages is not backward compatible: current browser relay handlers pass complete frames directly to createRecordMerger, which validates exact record length. No unnegotiated framing change was made.
